# truenas_dataset_set_quota (Action)

Sets user, group, or dataset quotas on a dataset (pool.dataset.set_quota). A quota_value of 0 removes that quota.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Full path of the dataset, e.g. "tank/data".
- `quotas` (Attributes List) Quota entries to apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quotas))

<a id="nestedatt--quotas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quotas`

Required:

- `id` (String) UID/username or GID/group name the quota applies to (ignored for DATASET; use "").
- `quota_type` (String) DATASET, USER, USEROBJ, GROUP, or GROUPOBJ.
- `quota_value` (Number) Quota in bytes (or object count for *OBJ types). 0 removes the quota.
